pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Open-bed default, 0.8m wide x 4m long, 0.25m raised mulch mound; canopy approx 0.20m above bed.
v002: two rows of 16 plants (32 total). Six trifoliate leaves per plant, 576 geometric leaflets. Red seeded fruits and eight small five-petal flowers retained.
Pivot is the ground centre of the Y=0 short end. Tile translations (0,4*n,0). Geometry stays within the 0.8m x 4m footprint.
Dusty charcoal mulch roughness .79, specular .22, wrinkle-normal amplitude 20 percent of original. Solid geometric leaf silhouettes, two-sided foliage; no plant collision.
Editable deterministic parameters in build_strawberries_v002.py and scene PazFarm_parameters; all textures original CC0 procedural artwork.

projected_leaf_coverage.method: Orthographic XY union of material slots 2/3 triangles over .8 x 4 m; no alpha or rendering.

original_projected_leaf_coverage.method: Orthographic XY union of material slots 2/3 triangles over .8 x 4 m; no alpha or rendering.

parameters.notes: v002 changes the bed only. Unchanged optional low tunnel is retained in the original delivery. Bed, pivot and tile pitch remain unchanged.

extra.implementation: All source geometry and procedural textures authored for this delivery; no reference/satellite pixels used.
extra.scope: Strawberry bed only. Original low tunnel unchanged. No Unreal work.
